Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(null)
    val urls = listOf("https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2")
    val result = Crawlberg.batchScrape(engine, urls)
    println(result.completedCount)
    println(result.failedCount)
    println(result.totalCount)
}
```
